newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Coolgardie COG and North in mine pact.
newsitem.headline: Coolgardie COG and North in mine pact.

text.p: Coolgardie Gold NL said on Monday that it had signed a joint venture agreement which would give mining house North Ltd a 75 percent interest in the Gregory lead and zinc project in the state of Queensland.
The Gregory project was within tenements owned by Coolgardie covering about 675 square kilometres and was located 250 kilometres north west of Mt Isa and 40km south of the Century zinc deposit.
Preliminary exploration drilling at the site had identified zinc and lead mineralisation, Coolgardie said.
The most significant intersection to date was 11 metres at 8.2 percent zinc and 1.6 percent lead from a depth of 103 metres, the company said.
Under the terms of the agreement, North could earn a 75 percent interest in the project by spending A$10 million over five years.
The agreement was subject to confirmation of a formal agreement, drafting of which would commence immediately, Coolgardie said.
